gbm_population_evidence.quote: Neoplasms; High Grade Glioma; Glioblastoma Multiforme; Malignant Glioma of Brain; Anaplastic Astrocytoma of Brain; High-grade Glioma; Anaplastic Glioma; Giant Cell Glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: G207 is an oncolytic herpes simplex virus-1 (HSV) that has been successfully engineered to introduce mutations in the virus that enable it to selectively replicate in and kill cancer cells

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: HSV G207 With a Single Radiation Dose in Children With Recurrent High-Grade Glioma

role_evidence.quote: Single dose of HSV-1 (G207) infused through catheters into region(s) of tumor defined by MRI

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: oncolytic virus selectively replicating in and killing cancer cells, with antitumour immune response

coder_notes: Paediatric/young-adult population (age 3 to <22) with Ages CHILD, ADULT. Oncolytic virus is the only agent; 5 Gy radiotherapy not listed as an agent. Immunologic/tumour-microenvironment exploratory outcomes are not tied to a named molecular biomarker, so none recorded.
